description: Roro Lure by a group of fanatics who love lure fishing. Having launched since 2018, Roro Lure was put on the fishing reel repair tools, by Roro X Spool, Roro SIC Bearing consisting of tuning, refining fishing reel. Roro Lure has since gone on to expand the fishing repair collection into a full range of lure fishing, including micro cast spool, ceramic ball bearing, handle bearing, bearing stopper ring, handle knob cap remover, bearing check tool, handle knob, spool case, trust wrench and more accessories, as well as becoming one of the most renowned and coveted lure fishing repair studio store.
